name: Create and verify a WordPress draft after editor approval

parameters.content:
## Editor-approved draft only
Accepts approved plain-text paragraphs, escapes HTML and creates status=draft. Looks up the exact stable slug before creation, then reads the exact post ID.

Configure siteOrigin and enabled in Prepare Request. Bind one restricted WordPress Application Password using Basic Auth to all three HTTP nodes. Bind a separate ingress Header Auth credential.

No publish operation exists. Serialize requests per slug. WordPress slug creation is not atomic; a suffixed slug or unknown result needs manual reconciliation before retry. Never automatically retry a POST. Read the guide.
